messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} do you
want to {07 0b 00}play hide-and-seek,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 04 00}What?{01 00 00 14 00} "Hide-and-seek is for
kids," you say? {01 00 00 0a 00}You couldn't
be more wrong!
{07 1b 00}You just don't understand.{01 00 00 05 00}
You've lost touch with your
playful side, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0a 00} kas sa
tahad {07 0b 00}peitust mängida,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 04 00}Mis?{01 00 00 14 00} „Peitus on laste
mäng,” ütled? {01 00 00 0a 00}Sa ei saaks
rohkem eksida!
{07 1b 00}Sa lihtsalt ei mõista.{01 00 00 05 00} Sa
oled kaotanud sideme oma
mängulise poolega, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}You wanna
play hide-and-seek with me,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}I'm {01 00 00 05 00}pretty good at hiding,{01 00 00 05 00}
you know! {01 00 00 05 00}What with the
paparazzi and all.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Kas sa tahad
minuga peitust mängida,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Ma olen {01 00 00 05 00}peitmises päris hea,{01 00 00 05 00}
tead! {01 00 00 05 00}Kõigi nende
paparatsodega ja nii.

messages.en:
Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Are you
any good at hide-and-seek?

{07 17 00}I don't mean to brag or
anything but{01 00 00 05 00} I'm the
reigning champ at it.
{07 00 00}What do you think?{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}You think you're up for it,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 0b 00}Kas sa oled
peituses üldse hea?

{07 17 00}Ma ei taha kiidelda ega
midagi, aga{01 00 00 05 00} mina olen selle
valitsev meister.
{07 00 00}Mida sa arvad?{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 0b 00}Kas sa arvad, et sa suudad,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}?!
